key_insight: SPOD-GPR combines spectral structure and Gaussian process regression to improve parametric flow predictions and uncertainty calibration over a POD-GPR baseline.
engineering_relevance: The method supports uncertainty-aware surrogate modelling for many-query and real-time applications, including fluid-flow digital twins.
method: Compress states with parametric POD, then window trajectories and retain energetic frequencies.
Apply SPOD at each retained frequency and learn parameter-dependent bases using aligned Grassmann charts and GPR.
Learn spectral coefficients directly and autoregressively; sample predictions jointly using Matheron conditioning.
evidence_signal: Across four parametric tests—two Kuramoto–Sivashinsky regimes, cylinder flow, and elliptic-obstacle flow—with parameters and prediction horizons outside training data, SPOD-GPR reduced normalised mean absolute error and improved uncertainty calibration versus POD-GPR.
watch_item: Accuracy and uncertainty calibration beyond the tested parameter ranges and prediction horizons remain unestablished.
paper_title: Parametric spatio-temporal reduced-order modelling via Spectral Proper Orthogonal Decomposition and Gaussian Process Regression
